# Forge City Circuit

Forge City Circuit is a fictional portfolio case study by Michael L. Lawson combining brand identity, product design, interaction design, and front-end development.

## Primary content

- `/` presents the visual project home and concise showcase.
- `/case-study/` presents the complete project case study.
- `/showcase/` redirects legacy links to the project home.
- `/portal/` presents a working fictional fan portal with standings, schedules, brackets, rosters, and team pages.
- `/crest/` presents an interactive three-dimensional study of the league crest.

The league, franchises, venues, schedules, results, and rosters are fictional. They exist to demonstrate the design system and product experience.
